meta.name: Logic Core Chapters
meta.description: A cinematic DevOps portfolio that combines Kage's chapter-like editorial composition with an interactive isometric infrastructure core, flowing diagnostics mesh, connectivity field, and restrained beam interactions.

primary.role: secondary deployment paths, section indices, and system controls

secondary.role: primary inspection signals, focus rings, topology nodes, and live status

accent.role: secondary topology accents and selected highlights

neutral.usage: White and #f4f7fb are primary foregrounds in dark mode; #07090d and #0d1118 form the canvas and panels. Light mode reverses this relationship without changing hierarchy.

color.contrast_strategy: Near-white editorial text on deep neutral fields with cyan, blue, and violet reserved for signals; all body text targets WCAG AA.

typography.font_style_notes: One Vietnamese-capable Roboto family across all roles; a monumental TRIEU wordmark and smaller editorial headline create the Kage-inspired scale contrast.

spacing.section_rhythm: Large cinematic pauses between sections, compact metadata clusters, and consistent 1rem or 1.5rem internal steps.

layout.grid_system: Twelve-column fluid editorial grid with system-diagram overlays
layout.alignment_tendency: Asymmetric editorial on desktop, single-column narrative on mobile

shape.border_usage: Precise one-pixel signal rules and angular clipped corners; pills are restricted to compact status indicators.
shape.divider_style: Low-contrast hairline with occasional cyan-to-violet gradient segment

elevation.shadow_style: Ambient glow plus constructed tonal layers
elevation.depth_cues: An isometric platform, flowing wireframe surface, routed pulses, restrained glow, foreground wordmark, and WebGL particle depth

iconography.preferred_set: Existing custom inline SVG system icons

motion.entrance_pattern: Premium fade with 0.985-to-1 scale and a short upward settle
motion.exit_pattern: Accelerated fade with minimal downward displacement
motion.philosophy: Premium technical choreography: primary content first, system evidence second, ambient field last; no overshoot and no decorative motion that competes with reading.

components.button_style: Angular 48px controls with a continuously rotating cyan-amber-violet gradient beam, dark inner fill, and compact directional icon
components.input_style: Dark ruled field with visible cyan focus ring and no floating label
components.card_style: Editorial signal panel with clipped corner, faint grid, and border highlight rather than conventional shadow
components.navigation_pattern: Sticky translucent command bar with visible primary routes, language state, theme, search, and GitHub
components.modal_style: Centered elevated command panel with dim backdrop, crisp border, and short premium transition
components.list_style: Numbered evidence rows on shared baselines with compact status and technology metadata
components.component_notes: Cards remain content-first; Three.js is a contextual layer, not an interaction requirement.

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: A deployable logic core viewed as an isometric infrastructure table
aesthetic.era_influence: Contemporary computational editorial with restrained retro-terminal cues

visual_language.whitespace_usage: Generous section whitespace with compact evidence groupings
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: Large typographic claims balanced by low-opacity spatial fields
visual_language.focal_strategy: A central isometric Logic Core balanced by a monumental foreground name and compact editorial copy
visual_language.texture_usage: Fine noise, sparse dot matrices, and subtle scan-grid registration

composition.hierarchy_method: Scale contrast, spatial isolation, and signal color
composition.flow_direction: Top-to-bottom chapter narrative with isometric diagonals and routed counter-motion
composition.grouping_strategy: Editorial sections, evidence rails, and bounded system diagrams
composition.negative_space_role: Creates calm around dense technical evidence and lets ambient 3D remain peripheral

imagery.photo_treatment: No decorative photography; company marks remain clean and high contrast
imagery.illustration_style: Isometric topology, diagnostic wire mesh, routed nodes, particle depth, and diagrammatic SVG
imagery.graphic_elements: Logic prism, deployment routes, connectivity rays, registration crosses, and clipped planes
imagery.pattern_usage: Sparse grid and dot field used at low opacity
imagery.image_shape: Wide landscape system canvases with small angular corners

interaction_feel.feedback_style: Immediate and precise with light, border, and 1-2px transform responses
interaction_feel.hover_behavior: Signal edge brightens while content lifts no more than 4px
interaction_feel.loading_style: Small infrastructure signal with percentage or status text

brand_voice_in_ui.tone: Direct, technically credible, and grounded in evidence
brand_voice_in_ui.empty_state_approach: Explain the next useful action in one concise sentence

overview.fallback_strategy: Render one static frame for reduced motion, reduce bloom and particle density on low-end devices, and retain a CSS isometric platform when WebGL fails.

background_effects.description: A full-viewport black field led by an isometric platform, luminous hexagonal logic prism, routed infrastructure nodes, flowing diagnostic mesh, and sparse particle dust.

params.speed: 0.006 radians per second ambient drift with slow diagnostic ripples
params.density: 180-520 dust points plus eight infrastructure nodes

particle_systems.description: Sparse depth dust surrounds the isometric table while eight brighter route pulses travel from the central logic prism to named infrastructure nodes.

params.movement_pattern: slow vertical drift with routed Bezier pulses
params.color_behavior: cyan with amber and violet system accents
params.interaction: pointer parallax, raycast node focus, and drag-to-orbit on desktop
params.spawn_area: rectangular depth field around the isometric infrastructure platform

3d_elements.description: A shader-scanned hexagonal Logic Core rises from a Flowing Mesh platform and connects to AWS, Kubernetes, GitOps, observability, Terraform, CI/CD, security, and runtime nodes.

params.renderer: WebGLRenderer with ACES tone mapping, antialiasing, DPR capped at 1.5, and EffectComposer
params.lighting: Shader-driven Fresnel rim, emissive route nodes, additive particles, and a restrained hemisphere/key/point-light set
params.camera: Perspective camera, 34 degree FOV, fixed isometric base angle with subtle pointer and scroll response
params.materials: Custom scan-band and diagnostic-wave ShaderMaterials, additive point sprites, emissive MeshStandardMaterial, and ruled wireframe
params.geometry: Hexagonal cylinder core, boxed platform, diagnostic plane, torus status ring, cube nodes, and quadratic route curves
params.interaction_model: Pointer parallax, drag-to-orbit, raycast node response, scroll-driven camera move; static fallback on touch/reduced-motion

shader_effects.description: The hexagonal core carries restrained scan-band displacement and Fresnel light while the wireframe platform emits radial diagnostic ripples.

params.vertex_manipulation: Low-amplitude vertical core scanning, radial sine-wave mesh displacement, and perspective-scaled point size
params.fragment_output: Cyan-to-amber Fresnel prism, energy-weighted cyan mesh lines, and feathered additive dust sprites
params.distortion: 1.8% core scan displacement and 18% localized diagnostic mesh ripple

parallax.speed_curve: GSAP scrub 0.6 with counter-motion between copy, HUD, and WebGL stage

scroll_triggered_animations.trigger_points: hero pinned from top to +=55vh; content enters at top 86%
scroll_triggered_animations.animation_type: pinned 3D scene transition, by-word hero reveal, project perspective settle, SVG path draw
scroll_triggered_animations.scrub_behavior: scrubbed hero and project depth; triggered once for supporting content

scroll_morphing.description: Desktop hero pins briefly while the isometric core advances, the monumental name drops through frame, and the editorial layers recede into the technology rail.

text_effects.description: The hero claim arrives by word with depth and a masked vertical reveal; selected signals retain the cyan-blue-violet highlight.

cursor_effects.description: Fine-pointer primary actions move at most 4px toward the cursor; the WebGL camera counter-moves.

params.interaction_zone: primary actions and WebGL canvas only

image_effects.description: System diagram canvases tilt by no more than two degrees and brighten their active route on hover.

canvas_drawings.description: A Canvas 2D constellation field radiates subtle infrastructure paths behind the profile and capability sections.

params.animation_loop: slow sine drift paused outside viewport
params.interaction: subtle pointer-origin parallax on fine pointers

svg_animations.description: Existing architecture routes draw once as each system diagram enters the viewport.

visual_effects.composite_notes: The Kage landing page supplies the chapter composition and monumental foreground typography. Logic Core supplies the central isometric infrastructure metaphor; Flowing Mesh supplies the diagnostic platform surface; Connectivity Graph supplies the Canvas 2D profile field; Gradient Beam CTA supplies the primary button edge treatment. The scene remains behind semantic HTML. GSAP pins and resolves the layered hero on desktop. Mobile removes pinning, labels, featured card, and bloom; reduced-motion receives a static Three.js frame, static connectivity field, complete text, and no continuous spatial movement.
